title: Founder Live Approval Capture Operator Review
objective: Define governed local operator-review boundaries for future approval capture decisions without granting approval capture, approval persistence, approval writes, runtime admission, execution unlock, mutation, deploy, network, or spend authority.
safetyRules: No approval capture writes that unlock execution.
No runtime admission or live mode transition.
No deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend.
No raw private project IDs in primary Command Center UX.
No full Command Center demo leakage.
reuseRequired: existing dashboard cards, tabs, badges, route matrix, evidence, audit, and activity helpers

subphases.title: Operator Review Contract / Schema Baseline
subphases.narrowGoal: Define the P108 local operator-review boundary contract and schema without enabling approval capture, approval persistence, approval writes, execution unlock, runtime admission, or mutation.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.envelope: Result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, sourceCaptureAuditPreviewPhase, sourceCaptureAuditPreviewState, founderContextSummary, operatorReviewBoundaryShape, operatorReviewReadiness, requiredEvidence, forbiddenActions, requiredEvidenceCount, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, commandCenterVisible false, and all approval/operator/runtime/execution flags false.
expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.operatorReviewBoundaryShape: Display-safe local operator-review boundary with boundaryRef, displayLabel, sourceApprovalCapturePhase, currentState, auditPreviewCount, operatorReviewRecordCount, capturedOperatorDecisionCount 0, persistedOperatorDecisionCount 0, executionUnlockCount 0, runtimeAdmissionCount 0, requiredEvidence, missingEvidence, forbiddenActions, validationCommands, reviewQuestions, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, and all blocked flags false.
expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.operatorReviewReadiness: Local readiness summary with operatorReviewBoundaryReady, auditPreviewCount, operatorReviewRecordCount, blockedOperatorReviewRecordCount, captured/persisted/writable/operatorReviewWrite/operatorReviewUnlock/runtimeAdmission/executable/dispatchable/projectMutation/hostedDbMutation/providerSpend counts all zero except blocked counts.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: No Command Center source change in P108.1. Chat with NEXUS and Lite remain chat-only.

subphases.playwrightTests: No Playwright update in P108.1 because no UI files change. P108.4 must add focused Command Center route coverage.

subphases.docsRoadmap: Add P108 plan doc and platform roadmap section. Update README with P108.1 status.

finalSafetyChecks: Confirm P108.1 is schema and contract only.
Confirm operator decisions cannot be captured, persisted, written, or used to unlock execution.
